title: introduce-span-edge-indexer-and-path-anchored-cost-rollups
author: Asha Nair
release_notes: Adds span-edge indexer service, path-anchored cost rollups, and new dashboards; opt-in feature flag; no user-visible API changes.
description: Motivation: long-tail token cost and latency are often hard to attribute when spans are sparse or work is shared across services; this change introduces a compact span-edge indexer and path-anchored rollups so SREs and engineers can quickly attribute cost/latency to an application path (route+handler+model-variant). What this does: adds an OTLP processor that synthesizes directed span edges at ingest time and emits edge tuples, a lightweight indexer service that materializes path_key -> {token_count_ms_cost} rollups, a small schema addition (edge_id and path_key tags), and a new console dashboard with per-path cost/latency heatmap and an alert tuned for persistent 95th-percentile cost drift per-path. Backwards compatibility and rollout: indexer is opt-in via telemetry.config.enabled=false by default, legacy traces remain unchanged, and the rollout is feature-flag gated across regions with a canary population; no customer-facing breaking changes. Performance: added ~5% ingestion CPU at peak in our bench but yields ~25% faster root-cause detection on canary traffic due to pre-aggregated paths. Testing and validation: unit tests for extractor and aggregator, integration test harness with synthetic routes, e2e canary in us-west-2 with staged traffic, manual SLO guardrails during rollout. Checklist: run schema migration for new tags, update Prometheus scrape jobs to include span-edge metrics, update ops runbook, add console dashboard to release bundle. Related tasks: ENG-1129 (indexer implementation) and ENG-1194 (console and alerts).

summary: Adds an opt-in span-edge indexer that emits path-anchored cost/latency rollups and a dashboard + alert to surface long-tail cost regressions by application path.
